# Pipeline-neutral patterns — single source of truth for both workflows.
# One glob pattern per line. Each entry has a justification comment above it.
# Consumed by tj-actions/changed-files via files_from_source_file.
# See rm-github-workflows skill §DECISION TREE for classification rules.

# Root documentation — not compiled, not deployed, not read by any build tool
README.md
AGENTS.md
CHANGELOG.md
.gitattributes
.gitignore

# Docs directory — markdown only, no code or build config
docs/**

# GitHub config — dependabot.yml does not affect CI pipeline or deployment artifact
.github/dependabot.yml

# GitHub agent docs — instruction files for LLM agents, not build tools

.github/chatmodes/**/*.md

.mcp.json

# Editor/IDE config — workspace, formatting, settings; not build tools
.editorconfig
.vscode/**
*.code-workspace

.config/**

# Dev-only launch/settings files — never included in publish output
src/**/Properties/launchSettings.json

src/**/*.local.settings.json*

# Policy pipeline-neutral — local dev only, never called by CI, never deployed
tools/**
